candidates.title: Transform Your Core with These Kettlebell Exercises | Full Workout 💪
candidates.description:
Looking for a effective way to build a stronger core without sacrificing space or time? Standing kettlebell exercises are a game-changer! In this video, we'll take you through a series of standing kettlebell core exercises that will engage your entire core, including your abs, obliques, and lower back. With these exercises, you'll improve your overall core strength, stability, and balance. Whether you're a fitness enthusiast or just starting out, these standing kettlebell core exercises are perfect for anyone looking to take their workout to the next level. So, grab a kettlebell and get ready to build a stronger, leaner, and more powerful core!

Suggested sets and reps are included, so whether you're a beginner or looking to level up your fitness, you can follow along and challenge yourself! 💪

🏋️ Weight Selection Guide:
This workout includes 5 movements with different ideal weights based on complexity and range of motion:

✅ Suitcase Marches: 15-20kg (simple carry pattern - go heavier!)
✅ Around the World & Hand-to-Hand Pass: 10-16kg (rotational control matters)
✅ Halos & Chest Openers: 8-12kg (technical shoulder movements - lighter is safer)

New to kettlebells? Start with the lighter end of each range and focus on form first. You'll naturally progress as movements feel easier.

Pro tip: Using different weights for different exercises isn't complicated - it's smart training! It lets you challenge each movement pattern appropriately instead of being limited by your weakest link.

Don't have multiple kettlebells? An adjustable kettlebell (12-32kg) is a great investment - one purchase covers your entire progression!
